landingEyebrow: A calmer place for your credentials
landingTitle: Your passwords, all in one place.
landingBody: A personal vault for the details you need every day, with privacy and clarity at its heart.
faqA1: Yes. Sealero is zero-knowledge: your vault is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it. The server stores ciphertext only and can never read your passwords, notes, or TOTP secrets.
faqQ2: What happens if I forget my master password?
faqA2: Your master password never leaves your device and cannot be recovered by us. Use the 24-word recovery key you backed up at registration to regain access. Without it, the vault cannot be opened.
faqA3: The server is open source (AGPLv3) and free to self-host, with unlimited items and devices. The Pro plan covers the official hosted cloud, so you do not have to run a server yourself.
faqA4: Web is available now, with an Android app in development. Your vault syncs across devices when you use the official cloud or your own server.
faqQ5: Is the server code open source?
faqA5: Yes. The server is published under AGPLv3 on GitHub, so anyone can read, audit, and self-host it. The Android app stays closed source.
pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you want the official cloud.
pricingNote: Prices are tentative and may change before launch.
pricingProF2: Hosted sync, no server to run
termsS1Body: Sealero is a zero-knowledge password manager. The official cloud is provided as-is, and the open-source server (AGPLv3) may be self-hosted under its license.
termsS2Body: Your vault is encrypted on your device before it reaches any server. We cannot read your passwords, notes, or secrets, and we cannot recover a lost master password or recovery key.
termsS3Body: Do not use the service to store unlawful content, to abuse the service, or to impersonate others. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.
termsS4Body: The service is provided without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for loss of access caused by a forgotten master password or recovery key.
privacyS1Body: Sealero cannot read your vault. Passwords, notes, and secrets are encrypted on your device with keys we never receive.
privacyS2Body: The official cloud stores your account email, encrypted vault data, and operational logs (such as login attempts) needed to run the service. We do not sell personal data.
privacyS3Body: We do not collect your master password, your recovery key, or the plaintext contents of your vault. Self-hosted servers send us nothing.
privacyS4Body: The web app keeps a login session and preferences in your browser. Clearing browser data signs you out. Cloud backup credentials, if you enable them, stay in your browser.
